items.title_cn: 胰腺炎门诊与住院管理的区别是什么？
items.title_en: What are the differences between outpatient and inpatient management of pancreatitis?
items.abstract_cn: 对于轻度急性胰腺炎，门诊管理是一种可行的选择，可以降低成本并缩短住院时间，且不增加风险；然而，仍需正在进行的试验提供更多证据，以充分验证这些发现相对于住院治疗的优越性。
items.abstract_en: For mild acute pancreatitis, outpatient management is a viable option that can reduce costs and hospital stays without increasing risk; however, more evidence from ongoing trials is needed to fully validate these findings against inpatient care.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 对于轻度急性胰腺炎，门诊管理是一种可行选择，可降低费用和住院时间且不增加风险；但仍需正在进行的试验提供更多证据，以与住院治疗进行充分验证。

items.title_cn: 肝硬化患者ERCP后早期肝功能失代偿：单中心回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Early Hepatic Decompensation after ERCP in Patients with Cirrhosis: A Single‑center Retrospective Cohort Study
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：肝硬化患者经常需要接受内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP），但ERCP术后早期肝功能失代偿的负担尚未得到充分描述。方法：我们开展了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入67名确诊肝硬化并在2021年1月至2023年12月期间接受治疗性ERCP的成人患者。在ERCP前及术后72小时（本次住院期间）评估肝功能失代偿事件[腹水、肝肾综合征/急性肾损伤（HRS-AKI）、肝性脑病、静脉曲张出血、自发性细菌性腹膜炎]。所有患者均通过超声系统评估腹水。采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验分析Child-Pugh评分和MELD-Na的配对变化，采用精确McNemar检验分析配对分类结局。通过单变量logistic回归探索ERCP术后失代偿的预测因素，随后建立简化的探索性多变量模型。结果：平均年龄为65.2±11.0岁，73.1%为男性。Child-Pugh A/B/C级分布为19/35/13，终末期肝病模型钠（MELD-Na）中位数为13.0 [9.5–16.5]。ERCP前任何肝功能失代偿的发生率为23.9%，72小时时增至44.8%。Child-Pugh评分从7（6–9）升至8（7–9.5）（p<0.001），MELD-Na从13（9.25–16.75）升至15（10.00–18.00）（p<0.001）。腹水（23.9%至38.8%，p=0.006）和HRS-AKI（1.5%至10.4%，p=0.031）显著增加。在调整基线失代偿状态后，基线Child-Pugh评分仍与72小时失代偿独立相关。结论：肝硬化患者在ERCP术后72小时内新发或加重的早期肝功能失代偿较为常见。基线肝脏严重程度应指导围手术期风险分层和术后早期监测。
items.abstract_en: Background and Aims: Patients with cirrhosis frequently require endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), yet the burden of early hepatic decompensation after ERCP remains insufficiently characterized. Methods: We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study including 67 adults with established cirrhosis who underwent therapeutic ERCP between January 2021 and December 2023. Hepatic decompensation events [ascites, hepatorenal syndrome/acute kidney injury (HRS-AKI), hepatic encephalopathy, variceal bleeding, spontaneous bacterial peritonitis] were assessed before ERCP and at 72 hours post-procedure during index admission. Ascites was systematically evaluated by ultrasound in all patients. Paired changes in Child–Pugh points and MELD-Na were analyzed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and paired categorical outcomes using exact McNemar tests. Predictors of post-ERCP decompensation were explored using univariable logistic regression followed by a reduced exploratory multivariable model. Results: Mean age was 65.2±11.0 years and 73.1% were male. Child–Pugh class A/B/C distribution was 19/35/13, with a median model for end-stage liver disease sodium (MELD-Na) of 13.0 [9.5–16.5]. Any hepatic decompensation was present in 23.9% of patients before ERCP and increased to 44.8% at 72 hours. Child–Pugh points increased from 7 (6–9) to 8 (7–9.5) (p<0.001), and MELD-Na from 13 (9.25–16.75) to 15 (10.00–18.00) (p<0.001). Ascites (23.9% to 38.8%, p=0.006) and HRS-AKI (1.5% to 10.4%, p=0.031) increased significantly. Baseline Child–Pugh score remained independently associated with 72-hour decompensation after adjustment for baseline decompensation status. Conclusions: Early new or worsening hepatic decompensation within 72 hours after ERCP is frequent in patients with cirrhosis. Baseline liver severity should inform peri-procedural risk stratification and early post-procedure monitoring.
items.journal: Journal of Gastrointestinal and Liver Diseases
items.summary_cn: 在肝硬化患者中，治疗性ERCP后72小时内新发或加重的肝功能失代偿较为常见，任何失代偿比例从术前23.9%升至44.8%，腹水（23.9%→38.8%）和HRS-AKI（1.5%→10.4%）显著增加，Child-Pugh评分与MELD-Na均显著恶化。基线Child-Pugh评分是72小时失代偿的独立相关因素，提示应据此进行围手术期风险分层和术后早期监测。

items.title_cn: 结合计算机断层扫描与内镜表现识别胰头癌穿透十二指肠导致的假性动脉瘤破裂：一例病例报告
items.title_en: Integration of computed tomography and endoscopic findings in identifying pseudoaneurysm rupture associated with duodenal penetration by pancreatic head cancer: A case report
items.abstract_cn: 胰头癌可通过侵犯十二指肠及肿瘤相关动脉受累导致危及生命的上消化道出血。在此类患者中，鉴别良性消化性溃疡病与肿瘤侵犯或穿透在临床上具有重要意义，因为这一鉴别可能影响是选择内镜治疗还是选择血管造影并可能行血管内治疗。我们报告一例66岁男性患者，因不可切除的胰头腺癌接受化疗，因黑便就诊。与化疗前计算机断层扫描相比，入院时增强计算机断层扫描显示肿瘤缩小；然而，累及残留胰头病灶及邻近胰周区域的气体及含气低密度区提示肿瘤坏死和/或与胃肠道腔相通。在残留胰头肿瘤内还发现一处局灶性动脉瘤样病变。内镜检查显示十二指肠球部深溃疡，无活动性出血。综合上述发现，提示十二指肠穿透伴肿瘤相关动脉受累。患者随后发生失血性休克，急诊血管造影显示假性动脉瘤破裂，与计算机断层扫描所见的动脉瘤样病变相对应。经导管动脉栓塞术实现了止血，随访内镜显示溃疡底部弹簧圈外露。本病例强调，即使内镜检查未显示活动性出血，仔细整合计算机断层扫描与内镜发现可能有助于识别十二指肠穿透伴肿瘤相关假性动脉瘤破裂。
items.abstract_en: Pancreatic head cancer may cause life-threatening upper gastrointestinal bleeding through duodenal invasion and tumor-related arterial involvement. In such patients, differentiating between benign peptic ulcer disease and tumor invasion or penetration is clinically important because this distinction may influence whether endoscopic management or angiography with possible endovascular treatment is pursued. We report a 66-year-old man receiving chemotherapy for unresectable pancreatic head adenocarcinoma who presented with melena. Compared with pre-chemotherapy computed tomography, contrast-enhanced computed tomography on admission showed tumor shrinkage; however, air and a gas-containing low-attenuation area involving the residual pancreatic head lesion and adjacent peripancreatic region suggested tumor necrosis and/or communication with the gastrointestinal lumen. A focal aneurysmal lesion was also identified within the residual pancreatic head tumor. Endoscopy revealed a deep duodenal bulb ulcer without active bleeding. Together, these findings suggested duodenal penetration with tumor-related arterial involvement. The patient subsequently developed hemorrhagic shock, and emergency angiography demonstrated pseudoaneurysm rupture corresponding to the aneurysmal lesion seen on computed tomography. Transcatheter arterial embolization achieved hemostasis, and follow-up endoscopy showed coil exposure at the ulcer base. This case highlights that careful integration of computed tomography and endoscopic findings may help identify duodenal penetration with tumor-related pseudoaneurysm rupture, even when endoscopy shows no active bleeding.
items.summary_cn: 本病例报告显示，胰头癌可因十二指肠侵犯及肿瘤相关动脉受累导致致命性上消化道出血；对比增强CT发现的残余胰头病灶内局灶性动脉瘤样病变及气体/含气低密度区提示肿瘤坏死和/或与消化道腔相通，结合内镜下深部十二指肠球部溃疡（无活动性出血）可提示十二指肠穿透伴肿瘤相关动脉受累，随后血管造影证实假性动脉瘤破裂并经经导管动脉栓塞止血。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎并发广泛动脉血栓形成：一例病例报告及文献综述
items.title_en: Extensive Arterial Thrombosis Complicating Acute Pancreatitis: A Case Report and Literature Review
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题报告了急性胰腺炎并发广泛动脉血栓形成的病例，并附文献综述；由于未提供摘要，无法提取更具体的核心发现。

items.title_cn: 支持大承气汤对重症急性胰腺炎肠道色氨酸代谢、AhR相关免疫修复及肺损伤作用的原始数据
items.title_en: Raw data supporting the effects of Dachengqi decoction on intestinal tryptophan metabolism, AhR-associated immune repair and lung injury in severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 该数据集包含支持大承气汤（DCQD）治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关急性肺损伤（SAP-ALI）研究的实验数据，重点关注肠腔内色氨酸代谢、芳香烃受体（AhR）信号通路、2型和3型固有淋巴细胞（ILC2/ILC3）应答以及肠道屏障功能。文件按实验模态组织，包括组织学和免疫荧光图像、电子显微镜图像、western blot数据、流式细胞术数据、定量PCR数据、ELISA测量、血清淀粉酶测量、肠道通透性测量以及Ahr基因分型记录。该数据集还包括16S rRNA基因测序数据、靶向色氨酸代谢组学数据及相关分析输出。实验包括SAP-ALI小鼠模型、使用Ficz进行药理学AhR激活、Ahr缺陷小鼠以及暴露于回肠内容物上清液的原代ILC2/ILC3培养。主要实验分组为对照组、SAP组、DCQD治疗的SAP组和Ficz治疗的SAP组。对于16S rRNA基因测序文件，前缀C、S、D和F分别表示这些组。其他分组定义和实验流程在随附的手稿和补充材料中提供。该数据集包含原始实验记录和处理后的分析文件。文件保留其原始名称和文件夹组织结构，以便于溯源。专有格式可能需要相应的仪器软件或兼容的分析软件。
items.abstract_en: This dataset contains experimental data supporting the study of Dachengqi decoction (DCQD) in severe acute pancreatitis-associated acute lung injury (SAP-ALI), with a focus on luminal tryptophan metabolism, aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) signaling, group 2 and group 3 innate lymphoid cell (ILC2/ILC3) responses, and intestinal barrier function. The files are organized by experimental modality and include histological and immunofluorescence images, electron microscopy images, western blot data, flow cytometry data, quantitative PCR data, ELISA measurements, serum amylase measurements, intestinal permeability measurements, and Ahr genotyping records. The dataset also includes 16S rRNA gene sequencing data, targeted tryptophan metabolomics data, and associated analysis outputs. Experiments comprise a mouse model of SAP-ALI, pharmacological AhR activation with Ficz, Ahr-deficient mice, and primary ILC2/ILC3 cultures exposed to ileal content supernatants. The principal experimental groups are control, SAP, DCQD-treated SAP, and Ficz-treated SAP. For the 16S rRNA gene sequencing files, the prefixes C, S, D, and F denote these groups, respectively. Additional group definitions and experimental procedures are provided in the accompanying manuscript and supplementary materials. The dataset contains both original experimental records and processed analysis files. Files retain their original names and folder organization to facilitate traceability. Proprietary formats may require the corresponding instrument software or compatible analysis software.
items.summary_cn: 该数据集提供了大黄承气汤治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关急性肺损伤的实验数据，聚焦肠腔色氨酸代谢、AhR信号通路、ILC2/ILC3应答及肠道屏障功能，涵盖小鼠SAP-ALI模型、AhR激动剂Ficz处理、Ahr缺陷小鼠及原代ILC2/ILC3培养等实验。

items.title_cn: CaMKIIδ磷酸化AUP1通过介导PERK依赖性未折叠蛋白反应促进胰腺组织修复及腺泡-导管化生形成
items.title_en: CaMKIIδ Phosphorylates AUP1 to Promote Pancreatic Tissue Repair and Acinar‐to‐Ductal Metaplasia Formation via Mediating PERK‐Dependent Unfolded Protein Responses
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 急性胰腺炎（AP）后的胰腺修复对于恢复组织完整性至关重要，但协调腺泡可塑性与再生的内在机制仍知之甚少。异常的Ca²⁺信号驱动腺泡损伤，但Ca²⁺响应性效应分子是否调控损伤后修复仍不清楚。本研究鉴定钙/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶II δ（CaMKIIδ）作为胰腺再生的修复相关调控因子。全局性Camk2d缺失延迟雨蛙素诱导的AP后的修复，而不改变初始损伤严重程度。骨髓嵌合体和胰腺特异性Camk2d缺失进一步证明，胰腺来源而非骨髓来源的CaMKIIδ是高效组织修复所必需的。转录组学和超微结构分析揭示，Camk2d缺陷破坏内质网（ER）稳态并增强PERK依赖性未折叠蛋白反应激活。Camk2d缺陷胰腺在体内显示腺泡-导管化生（ADM）程序受损，在离体3D培养中显示ADM形成缺陷。对腺泡来源ADM的整合蛋白质组学和磷酸化蛋白质组学分析鉴定出古老泛在蛋白1（AUP1）——一种ER相关降解调控因子——为此前未被认识的CaMKIIδ依赖性底物候选分子。功能分析表明，AUP1含S280的富含丝氨酸区域的磷酸化促进K48连接泛素化，并在胰腺应激条件下抑制PERK依赖性ER应激。这些发现定义了CaMKIIδ–AUP1轴，将Ca²⁺响应性激酶活性与ER蛋白质稳态、ADM形成和胰腺修复联系起来。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Pancreatic repair after acute pancreatitis (AP) is essential for restoring tissue integrity, but the intrinsic mechanisms coordinating acinar plasticity and regeneration remain poorly understood. Aberrant Ca 2 + signaling drives acinar injury, but whether Ca 2 + ‐responsive effectors regulate post‐injury repair remains unclear. This study identifies calcium/calmodulin‐dependent protein kinase II δ (CaMKIIδ) as a repair‐associated regulator of pancreatic regeneration. Global Camk2d deletion delays repair after caerulein‐induced AP without altering initial injury severity. Bone marrow chimeras and pancreas‐specific Camk2d deletion further demonstrate that pancreatic, rather than bone marrow‐derived, CaMKIIδ is required for efficient tissue repair. Transcriptomic and ultrastructural analyses reveal that Camk2d deficiency disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis and enhances PERK‐dependent unfolded protein response activation. Camk2d ‐deficient pancreas shows impaired acinar‐to‐ductal metaplasia (ADM) programs in vivo and defective ADM formation in ex vivo 3D culture. Integrated proteomic and phosphoproteomic profiling of acinar‐derived ADM identifies ancient ubiquitous protein 1 (AUP1), an ER‐associated degradation regulator, as a previously unrecognized CaMKIIδ‐dependent substrate candidate. Functional analyses show that phosphorylation of the AUP1 S280‐containing serine‐rich region promotes K48‐linked ubiquitination and restrains PERK‐dependent ER stress under pancreatic stress conditions. These findings define a CaMKIIδ–AUP1 axis linking Ca 2 + ‐responsive kinase activity to ER proteostasis, ADM formation and pancreatic repair.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现CaMKIIδ是胰腺再生修复的调控因子，其缺失会延迟急性胰腺炎后的组织修复并损害腺泡-导管化生（ADM），机制上CaMKIIδ通过磷酸化AUP1的S280富丝氨酸区域促进K48连接泛素化，从而抑制PERK依赖性未折叠蛋白反应。

items.title_cn: 高D-二聚体的高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎中抗凝血酶III降低与院内器官衰竭：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Reduced antithrombin III and in-hospital organ failure in hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis with elevated D-dimer: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 D-二聚体广泛用于反映急性胰腺炎中的凝血和纤溶激活，但D-二聚体升高患者之间的结局存在差异。抗凝血酶III（AT-III）降低可能提示全身凝血激活过程中内源性抗凝储备减少。我们评估了在高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）且D-二聚体升高的患者中，AT-III降低与住院期间器官衰竭之间的关联。方法 本回顾性队列研究纳入2020年10月至2025年11月住院的HTG-AP患者。根据本地实验室参考范围，D-二聚体升高定义为> 0.55 mg/L FEU，AT-III降低定义为< 75%。主要结局为住院期间器官衰竭。2020-2023年和2024-2025年入院的患者分别描述为早期入院队列和后期入院队列。在D-二聚体升高的患者中，采用二元logistic回归评估AT-III降低与器官衰竭之间的关联。主要模型校正了年龄、性别、ln(D-二聚体)、ln(甘油三酯)和ln(从症状发作至入院时间+1)。结果 在959例具有完整入院D-二聚体和AT-III数据的患者中，79例（8.2%）在住院期间发生器官衰竭。在418例D-二聚体升高的患者中，AT-III降低的151例患者中有44例（29.1%）发生器官衰竭，而AT-III保持正常的267例患者中有25例（9.4%）发生器官衰竭。在包括连续ln(D-二聚体)的校正后，AT-III降低仍与器官衰竭相关（比值比[OR] 3.30，95%置信区间[CI] 1.86-5.85；P < 0.001）。在早期和后期入院队列中，AT-III降低者对应的观察事件率分别为27.8%和31.5%，而AT-III保持正常者分别为9.5%和9.2%。结论 在HTG-AP且D-二聚体升高的患者中，AT-III降低与住院期间器官衰竭的观察频率较高相关。这些发现支持进一步评估AT-III作为HTG-AP中常规可用的凝血标志物。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background D-dimer is widely used to reflect coagulation and fibrinolytic activation in acute pancreatitis, but outcomes vary among patients with elevated D-dimer. Reduced antithrombin III (AT-III) may indicate diminished endogenous anticoagulant reserve during systemic coagulation activation. We assessed the association between reduced AT-III and organ failure during hospitalization among patients with hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) and elevated D-dimer. Methods This retrospective cohort study included hospitalized patients with HTG-AP from October 2020 to November 2025. D-dimer elevation was defined as > 0.55 mg/L FEU and AT-III reduction as < 75%, according to local laboratory reference ranges. The primary outcome was organ failure during hospitalization. Patients admitted in 2020–2023 and 2024–2025 were described as the earlier and later admission cohorts, respectively. Among patients with elevated D-dimer, binary logistic regression was used to evaluate the association between reduced AT-III and organ failure. The main model adjusted for age, sex, ln(D-dimer), ln(triglycerides), and ln(time from symptom onset to admission + 1). Results Of 959 patients with complete admission D-dimer and AT-III data, 79 (8.2%) had organ failure during hospitalization. Among 418 patients with elevated D-dimer, organ failure occurred in 44 of 151 patients (29.1%) with reduced AT-III and in 25 of 267 patients (9.4%) with preserved AT-III. After adjustment including continuous ln(D-dimer), reduced AT-III remained associated with organ failure (odds ratio [OR] 3.30, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.86–5.85; P < 0.001). The corresponding observed event rates in the earlier and later admission cohorts were 27.8% and 31.5% with reduced AT-III, compared with 9.5% and 9.2% with preserved AT-III. Conclusions Among patients with HTG-AP and elevated D-dimer, reduced AT-III was associated with a higher observed frequency of organ failure during hospitalization. These findings support further evaluation of AT-III as a routinely available coagulation marker in HTG-AP.
items.summary_cn: 在伴D-二聚体升高的高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎患者中，抗凝血酶III降低者住院期间器官衰竭发生率显著高于抗凝血酶III正常者（29.1% vs 9.4%），校正年龄、性别、D-二聚体、甘油三酯及发病至入院时间后，抗凝血酶III降低仍与器官衰竭独立相关（OR 3.30，95%CI 1.86–5.85）。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
